name: molecular-interfaces
title: Molecular Interfaces
question: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) frames a molecule not as a lump of state but as a typed interface exposing several physical channels -- chemical, electrostatic, mechanical, thermal -- through which molecules bind, react, and transmit force and heat. It even names the public databases (PDB, Reactome, ChEBI, GO) as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types". This study asks the discriminating question one channel down: does that molecular interface hold SPATIALLY? Concretely -- do local molecular reactions plus differential diffusion (the CHEMICAL channel spatialized as finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterning -- not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto) turn a near-uniform seed into emergent spatial structure, and does a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADE that structure -- so that a temperature PARAMETER demonstrably modulates the spatialized chemical channel over one shared spatial field? The causal control -- equal diffusion (Du = Dv), chemistry untouched -- differs in exactly one variable and isolates the diffusion asymmetry as the cause of structure (a regime-specific conclusion for this Gray-Scott system), so the contrast between pattern and uniformity is the finding.
biological_summary:
The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) makes a molecule a typed interface: it exposes physical channels -- chemical fluxes, electrostatic fields, mechanical forces, thermal transfer -- and its identity is the shape of those channels, not a scalar concentration. A coarser, specification-stage, point-scale lumped realization made ONE molecule's four channels executable at a POINT (an F1Fo ATP synthase whose chemical/electrostatic/mechanical/thermal ports were wired as a typed draft and compiled). This study takes the CHEMICAL channel off the point and onto a 2D lattice, and adds a static uniform temperature field on top of it, to ask whether a temperature PARAMETER can modulate the spatialized chemical channel over one shared field. The chemical channel is realized as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system on a 128x128 periodic grid: a local autocatalytic chemistry (U + 2V -> 3V, V -> P) coupled to DIFFERENTIAL diffusion (Dv < Du), the route by which a near-uniform Gray-Scott state, seeded with finite-amplitude nucleation patches, breaks into spots -- finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven patterning, NOT the linear-instability Turing mechanism sensu stricto (cf. turing1952). The update is explicit-Euler du/dt = Du*lap(u) - U*V^2 + F*(1-U), dv/dt = Dv*lap(v) + U*V^2 - (F+k)*V on the periodic 5-point Laplacian, canonical spot regime Du=0.16, Dv=0.08, F=0.037, k=0.06, dt=1.0 (CFL max(Du,Dv)*dt*4 = 0.64 < 1, guarded at construction). The thermal channel is a second, orthogonal port: when a static uniform temperature field is present the reaction term is scaled elementwise by the Arrhenius factor rate = exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) -- T above Tref speeds the chemistry, below slows it, and rate == 1 with no field. There is no heat transport and no reaction->heat feedback: the temperature field is a static rate MULTIPLIER, so the temperature parameter modulates the chemical channel additively rather than being a second physically-transported channel. Realizing the paper's databases claim, honestly. The paper calls PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types"; this study makes that concrete not as a resolved database lookup but as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species and reactions. Read U as a ChEBI-style substrate type, V as an activator/inhibitor species, P as the product sink, and U + 2V -> 3V as a Reactome-style autocatalytic reaction record (placeholder identifiers, e.g. CHEBI:/CHEBI:/CHEBI:

and REACT:) -- a concrete gesture at what it would mean for a database entry to TYPE a molecular interface, not a claim that these toy species resolve to real PDB structures or Reactome pathway fragments. A genuine Reactome-fragment mapping, or a live database fetch that types the ports against real entries, is a named deferral, not a result here. Measured this build. The CHEMICAL channel patterns: from the near-uniform seed the inhibitor field's spatial variance v_var rises from ~0.0011 toward ~0.0119 by 8000 internal steps and the field resolves into ~12 connected v-domains (patterned == 1.0). The equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12, chemistry identical) stays UNIFORM -- v_var ~= 0 (patterned == 0.0) -- so the structure is caused by the diffusion asymmetry (a finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven instability, not linear-Turing sensu stricto), not by the chemistry alone: removing only the differential diffusion removes the pattern (a regime-specific conclusion for this Gray-Scott system). The THERMAL channel GRADES that pattern rather than destroying it: a raised uniform temperature field (Ea=0.15, Tref=1.0, T=1.2) coarsens the flagship from ~12 domains to ~2 and lowers v_var from ~0.0119 to ~0.0096 while staying comfortably patterned -- a temperature parameter modulating the chemical channel, not a chemistry collapse. (An earlier, hotter setting Ea=1.0/T=1.5 was found to OVERSHOOT -- the reaction runs away and collapses the pattern to near-uniform -- and was retuned to the milder graded setting; the overshoot is pinned as a direct-physics assertion so "graded, not collapsed" is tested against its own failure mode.) Because the physics has no RNG, the multi-seed check re-draws the near-uniform seed for seeds 1-5 and reports a RANGE: v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- the pattern forms for every seed, stated as a band rather than a single golden value. Scope -- the four-modality finding. This study spatializes ONE of the molecular interface's four physical channels -- the CHEMICAL channel (finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterning) -- and modulates it with a temperature PARAMETER (a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier; no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback). The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named gap -- no charge field, no force or tension, is exposed or measured here (owned in investigation.yaml's what_this_does_not_demonstrate, as a named deferral). And this is a TOY reaction-diffusion demonstration: emergent spatial structure from a minimal autocatalytic chemistry with tuned, uncalibrated constants, NOT real molecular structure or conformation (nothing at PDB resolution), NOT a fitted reaction network, NOT a resolved database mapping. What is demonstrated is that a temperature parameter modulates the spatialized chemical channel over one shared field (one physical channel modulated by a temperature parameter, not two physically-transported channels composing); what is not is the other channels, real molecular structure, and a live database type system.
claim: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) holds spatially for its CHEMICAL channel, and a temperature parameter modulates it. The CHEMICAL channel, realized as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du), turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto): v_var rises from ~0.0011 to ~0.0119 with ~12 connected domains (patterned == 1.0). The equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12, chemistry unchanged -- the single differing variable) stays UNIFORM (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0), so the pattern is CAUSED by the diffusion asymmetry, not the chemistry alone -- a regime-specific conclusion for this Gray-Scott system. A static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADES the pattern (Ea=0.15, T=1.2: ~12 domains -> ~2, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned: a temperature parameter modulating the chemical channel, not a second physically-transported channel and not a collapse. Multi-seed (seeds 1-5, physics is deterministic so the seed is re-drawn into the initial field): v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- reported as a range. The boundaries are findings, not caveats: the ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named four-modality gap; the databases claim (PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as partial specifications of molecular-interface types) is realized as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species, not a resolved mapping; and this is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration, not real molecular structure or conformation.
key_assumptions: The interface tested here is the paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7): a molecule as a typed interface exposing physical channels (chemical, electrostatic, mechanical, thermal). This study realizes the CHEMICAL channel spatially as Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V, V -> P plus differential diffusion Dv < Du -- finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven patterning, not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto; cf. turing1952) and adds a temperature PARAMETER as a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius elementwise rate multiplier exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)) on the reaction term (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback). The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are NOT realized -- they are the named four-modality gap, not demonstrated here.

The databases hook is ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation, not a resolved mapping. The paper names PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types"; here that is gestured at by TYPING the Gray-Scott species and reaction with placeholder database-style identifiers (U/V/P as ChEBI-style substrate/activator/product types, U + 2V -> 3V as a Reactome-style autocatalytic reaction record). This is a concrete gesture at what typing a molecular interface against a database would mean -- NOT a claim that these toy species resolve to real PDB structures, Reactome pathway fragments, or ChEBI/GO entries. A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch is a deferral.

The pattern is CAUSED by the differential-diffusion instability (finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven, not linear-Turing sensu stricto), and this is shown by a single-variable causal control, not assumed. The flagship (Du=0.16, Dv=0.08) and the equal-diffusion control (Du=Dv=0.12) share identical chemistry (F, k), identical seed, identical wiring and step count; the ONLY difference is whether diffusion is differential. Removing the asymmetry removes the pattern (v_var ~= 0, exactly 0.0 in the control), isolating differential diffusion -- not the reaction alone -- as the cause of spatial structure.

The temperature parameter modulates the chemical channel additively, not as a re-parameterization of it. The reaction term is scaled by rate = exp(-Ea*(1/T - 1/Tref)); with NO temperature field present rate == 1 everywhere and the process is pure chemistry, byte-identical to the chemical-only flagship. The thermal composite differs from the flagship in exactly the Arrhenius parameters and the presence of a raised static uniform temperature field -- Du/Dv/F/k/dt/steps_per_tick are held equal (asserted in tests/test_molecular_regime.py), so the coarsening is attributable to the temperature parameter, not to a changed chemistry or diffusion regime. The temperature field is a static rate multiplier with no heat transport and no reaction->heat feedback -- this is one physical channel modulated by a temperature parameter, not two physically-transported channels composing.

The parameters are tuned demonstration values, not fitted. The canonical spot regime (Du=0.16, Dv=0.08, F=0.037, k=0.06, dt=1.0) sits in the classic Gray-Scott spot window and comfortably inside the explicit reaction-diffusion CFL limit (max(Du,Dv)*dt*4 = 0.64 < 1; the process raises on an unstable config rather than drifting silently to NaN). The thermal setting (Ea=0.15, T=1.2) was chosen to GRADE rather than collapse: a hotter Ea=1.0/T=1.5 was found to overshoot into near-uniform collapse and was retuned. No literature acceptance band is claimed -- this is a demonstration primitive of the molecular interface's chemical and thermal channels made spatial, not a model of a specific molecule or medium.

The physics is DETERMINISTIC -- it has no RNG. The GrayScott process accepts a seed config key but it is currently inert (documented in meta_modelers_guide/molecular/gray_scott.py), so the composites bake a static seed_uv(seed=1) draw into fields.u/fields.v at build time. The multi-seed test therefore re-draws the INITIAL near-uniform field with seed_uv(seed=s) for s in 1-5 (everything else held fixed) and reports the resulting band -- v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] -- as genuine sensitivity of the emergent pattern to the nucleation-patch placement, not as a per-tick stochastic process.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical differential-diffusion Gray-Scott regime (Du > Dv) destabilizes a near-uniform seed into a finite-amplitude spot pattern (many discrete domains, not one blob).
Removing only the diffusion asymmetry (Du = Dv, chemistry unchanged) removes the pattern -- the control stays uniform, isolating differential diffusion as the cause (regime-specific to Gray-Scott).

A temperature parameter (a static uniform field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier) modulates the chemical pattern -- grading it rather than collapsing it -- rather than being a second physically-transported channel.

units_and_time.time: 1 tick = unspecified physical time (dimensionless model time); each tick is steps_per_tick=500 internal explicit-Euler steps at dt=1.0 dimensionless, and the run is 16 ticks (8000 steps).
units_and_time.quantities: u/v/p composition fields, v_var, F, k, and the diffusion coefficients Du/Dv are dimensionless model units; the temperature T=1.2, Tref=1.0 and activation Ea=0.15 are dimensionless Arrhenius parameters, NOT calibrated Kelvin or kJ/mol -- the temperature field is a static uniform rate multiplier, not a physically-transported heat field.
units_and_time.note: No literature acceptance band is claimed; these are tuned demonstration values, not fitted.

behavior_tests.name: thermal-channel-still-patterns
behavior_tests.description: The temperature parameter GRADES rather than destroys: with a static uniform temperature field (Ea=0.15, Tref=1.0, T=1.2) acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier on the reaction (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback), the field is still comfortably patterned (patterned == 1.0, v_var above the floor) -- a temperature parameter modulating the chemical channel, not a chemistry collapse.

findings.statement: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) CHEMICAL channel holds spatially: a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du) turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto) -- v_var rises ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119 and the field resolves into ~12 connected domains (patterned == 1.0). Local molecular reactions plus differential diffusion produce emergent spatial structure, the molecular interface's chemical channel made spatial.

The pattern is CAUSED by the differential-diffusion asymmetry, shown by a single-variable causal control. The equal-diffusion control (Du = Dv = 0.12 -- identical chemistry, seed, and wiring, the only difference the removal of the differential-diffusion asymmetry) stays UNIFORM: v_var ~= 0 (exactly 0.0), patterned == 0.0. Removing only the diffusion asymmetry removes the structure, isolating differential diffusion -- not the chemistry alone -- as its cause. This "differential diffusion is the cause" conclusion is regime-specific for this Gray-Scott system.

A temperature PARAMETER modulates the chemical channel over the same field: a static uniform temperature field (Ea=0.15, Tref=1.0, T=1.2) acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier on the reaction (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADES the pattern rather than destroying it -- coarsening it from ~12 domains to ~2 and lowering v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096 while staying comfortably patterned (patterned == 1.0). This is a temperature parameter modulating one physical channel, NOT two physically-transported channels composing. (A hotter Ea=1.0/T=1.5 setting overshoots into near-uniform collapse and was retuned; the overshoot is pinned as a direct-physics assertion, so "graded, not collapsed" is tested against its own failure mode.) The chemical channel is spatialized and a temperature parameter demonstrably modulates it.

The pattern forms for every seed; v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193] and n_domains in [8, 12] are reported as a RANGE reflecting genuine sensitivity of the emergent pattern to nucleation-patch placement, not dressed as a single golden value.

The four-modality gap (electrostatic + mechanical), the toy-scope boundary, and the illustrative (not resolved) database typing are reported as findings, not claimed away.

explanatory_gain.basis: Putting the paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) on the lattice turns "a molecule is a typed interface exposing physical channels" into a spatial mechanism where the chemical channel is spatialized (finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott patterning, causally isolated by the equal-diffusion control) and a temperature parameter (a static uniform Arrhenius rate multiplier) demonstrably modulates it over one shared field. It takes a coarser, point-scale lumped realization, which made one molecule's four channels executable at a POINT (F1Fo ATP synthase), and makes the chemical channel SPATIAL, adding a temperature parameter that modulates it -- not a second physically-transported channel.

conclusion:
## Claims

- The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) chemical channel holds as a 2D spatial mechanism: a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du) turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto; v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119, ~12 domains, patterned == 1.0), while the single-variable equal-diffusion causal control (Du = Dv = 0.12) stays UNIFORM (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0). Removing only the diffusion asymmetry removes the pattern (a regime-specific conclusion for this Gray-Scott system).

- A temperature parameter modulates the chemical channel: a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier (Ea=0.15, T=1.2; no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADES the pattern (~12 -> ~2 domains, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned -- a temperature parameter modulating one physical channel, not a second physically-transported channel and not a collapse.

## Evidence

- **PATTERN-FORMS** -- patterned == 1.0, v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119 over 8000 steps

- **PATTERN-HAS-MULTIPLE-DOMAINS** -- n_domains ~= 12 (multi-seed band [8, 12])

- **EQUAL-DIFFUSION-CONTROL-UNIFORM** -- Du=Dv=0.12: patterned == 0.0, v_var ~= 0 (single-variable causal control)

- **THERMAL-CHANNEL-STILL-PATTERNS** -- thermal patterned == 1.0, v_var ~= 0.0096 (graded, not collapsed)

- **THERMAL-CHANNEL-COARSENS** -- n_domains ~12 -> ~2 under the raised temperature field

- **PATTERN-IS-MULTISEED-ROBUST** -- v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] across seeds 1-5

## Limitations

- Only the CHEMICAL channel is spatialized as a genuine physical channel (Gray-Scott patterning); the THERMAL modality is a temperature PARAMETER (a static uniform Arrhenius rate multiplier, no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback), not a second physically-transported channel. The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named four-modality gap -- no charge field, no force or tension, is exposed or measured. So one physical channel is spatialized and a temperature parameter modulates it, not "two channels compose." Owned in investigation.yaml as a named deferral.

- This is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration with tuned, uncalibrated constants -- emergent spatial structure from a minimal autocatalytic chemistry, NOT real molecular structure or conformation (nothing at PDB resolution), not a fitted reaction network.

- The databases claim (PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as partial specifications of molecular-interface types) is realized as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species (U/V/P and the autocatalytic reaction given placeholder database-style identifiers), NOT a resolved mapping. A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch is deferred.

- The physics is deterministic (no RNG); the multi-seed range reflects sensitivity of the emergent pattern to the initial nucleation-patch placement, re-drawn into the initial field, not a per-tick stochastic process.

## Next steps

- The electrostatic and mechanical channels made spatial (a charge field driving electromigration; a mechanical force/tension coupling), so more than one of the molecular interface's four channels is genuinely spatialized as a physically-transported channel on one field.

- A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch that TYPES the Gray-Scott ports against actual ChEBI/Reactome entries, upgrading the illustrative typed-port annotation to a resolved database mapping.

the thermal run collapses instead of grading (v_var falls below the floor -- the Arrhenius rate is overshooting, as the retired Ea=1.0/T=1.5 setting did) or fails to coarsen (n_domains not below the flagship -- the temperature field is not reaching the reaction term)

limitations: Only the CHEMICAL channel is realized as a genuine spatial physical channel (finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterning, not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto). The THERMAL modality is a temperature PARAMETER, not a second physically-transported channel -- a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier, with no heat transport and no reaction->heat feedback. The ELECTROSTATIC and MECHANICAL channels are the named four-modality gap -- no charge field, no force or tension, is exposed or measured here. So one physical channel is spatialized and a temperature parameter modulates it; this is not "two physical channels compose." Owned in investigation.yaml's what_this_does_not_demonstrate, as a named deferral.

This is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration, NOT real molecular structure or conformation. What is demonstrated is emergent spatial structure from a minimal autocatalytic chemistry with tuned, uncalibrated constants -- nothing at PDB resolution, no fitted reaction network, no calibrated molecule.

The databases claim -- PDB/Reactome/ChEBI/GO as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types" -- is realized as an ILLUSTRATIVE typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species (U/V/P and the autocatalytic reaction annotated with placeholder database-style identifiers), a concrete gesture at typing a molecular interface, NOT a resolved mapping. A real Reactome-fragment mapping / live database fetch is a named deferral.

The parameters (Du=0.16, Dv=0.08, F=0.037, k=0.06, dt=1.0; thermal Ea=0.15, T=1.2) are tuned demonstration values, not fitted, and no literature acceptance band is claimed. The canonical regime sits inside the explicit reaction-diffusion CFL limit (max(Du,Dv)*dt*4 = 0.64 < 1; the process raises on an unstable config). The thermal setting was retuned from a hotter one (Ea=1.0/T=1.5) that overshoots into near-uniform collapse -- pinned as a direct-physics assertion so grading is tested against collapse.

The physics is deterministic -- no RNG. The GrayScott seed config is accepted but currently inert, so the multi-seed range (v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12]) is produced by re-drawing the initial near-uniform field for seeds 1-5, reflecting sensitivity to nucleation-patch placement, not a per-tick stochastic process.

Only the chemical channel is spatialized (with a temperature parameter modulating it); a point-scale predecessor drove all four channels (chemical, electrical, mechanical, thermal) from one coupled proton flux via a concrete rotary-ATP-synthase mechanism. Spatializing the electrical and mechanical channels as genuine physically-transported channels, and realizing a named molecular machine rather than a generic reaction-diffusion chemistry, remain open.
The specialized enzymatic subports (substrate, cofactor, catalyst, product) are not addressed; only the top-level chemical channel is realized spatially, modulated by a temperature parameter.
falsifiability: Overturned if the flagship fails to pattern within the 8000-step window (v_var stays near 0 or patterned != 1.0 -- differential diffusion not destabilizing the seed), if the equal-diffusion control DOES pattern (v_var rising with Du = Dv -- the structure not actually caused by the diffusion asymmetry), or if the thermal run collapses instead of grading (v_var below the pattern floor -- the Arrhenius rate overshooting, as the retired Ea=1.0/T=1.5 setting did) or fails to coarsen the pattern.

experiment: Run three Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion composites to completion through the process-bigraph engine directly from their JSON specs: molecular-turing-pattern (GrayScott, a 128x128 near-uniform seed under the canonical differential-diffusion spot regime Du=0.16/Dv=0.08, 8000 internal steps), molecular-equal-diffusion-control (the single-variable causal control, Du=Dv=0.12, identical chemistry and seed), and molecular-thermal-graded (identical chemistry/diffusion/seed plus a raised uniform temperature field T=1.2 Arrhenius-scaling the reaction, Ea=0.15). Measure whether the flagship patterns (v_var above the floor, patterned == 1.0, more than one domain) while the equal-diffusion control stays uniform (v_var ~= 0), and whether a temperature parameter grades the pattern (coarser -- fewer domains, lower but still-patterned v_var) rather than collapsing it; re-draw the initial field for seeds 1-5 and report v_var / n_domains as a range.
result: The chemical channel patterns -- the near-uniform Gray-Scott seed destabilizes under differential diffusion into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto; v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119, ~12 domains, patterned == 1.0) -- while the single-variable equal-diffusion causal control (Du=Dv=0.12) stays uniform (v_var ~= 0, patterned == 0.0), realizing the paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) chemical channel as a spatial mechanism and isolating differential diffusion as the cause (regime-specific to Gray-Scott). A temperature parameter modulates that same field -- a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier (Ea=0.15, T=1.2; no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) grades the pattern (~12 -> ~2 domains, v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096) while staying patterned, a temperature parameter modulating one physical channel, not a second physically-transported channel and not a collapse. The honest boundaries are reported as findings -- the electrostatic and mechanical channels are the named four-modality gap, this is a toy reaction-diffusion demonstration and not real molecular structure, and the databases claim is realized as illustrative typed-port annotation over the Gray-Scott species rather than a resolved mapping. Multi-seed: v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] across seeds 1-5, reported as a range.
